summary.text: Alexander Valiensi Kent is an independent candidate for Wisconsin's 3rd District from La Crosse. He has a background in social work and philosophy, wrote a 2024 book on online voting, and describes his campaign as independent, voter-directed and accepting no money from donors.

paragraphs.text: Lives in La Crosse, Wisconsin; earned a bachelor's degree from Viterbo University in 2014 and a graduate degree from the University of Chicago in 2016.
Describes his background as social work and philosophy; Ballotpedia lists his profession as social work.
Wrote the book "Voter Directed Democracy," published in 2024, which he describes as a political theory about bringing democratic republicanism online.
